pair.secretHint: Eight bytes kept by the accessory until a factory reset. One set up in PetKit's app needs that secret; a factory-fresh one accepts eight zero bytes.
pair.name: Name it (optional)
pair.identifierHint: Becomes its Home Assistant device id. Leave blank unless you want the id PetKit's app gave it.
pair.intervalHint: How often the relay opens a Bluetooth session to read it.
pair.scanTypeHint: 14 is the only value read off a real pairing (a W5). If an accessory never reports, try another number here.

ble.unpairBody: The relay stops reading it. Its Home Assistant entities stay until you delete the device there.
ble.pairDescription: It talks to the server through the {{name}}, which must stay on and nearby.
ble.importNote: Asks PetKit once, signed as the {{name}}, which accessories it owns, and copies each one’s Bluetooth address and pairing secret across. Nothing is sent to PetKit until you press it.
ble.title: Bluetooth accessories

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.noneBlocked: No blocked cloud attempts this week

raw.needsObject: Send an object with suffix and payload
raw.note: Publishes verbatim; nothing is added. Sent over MQTT if the device has a session, else queued for its heartbeat. Needs step-up.
raw.label: Raw command JSON

remove.title: Delete {{label}}?
remove.body: This permanently deletes the device from the registry and removes all its Home Assistant entities. Events and media are kept. A device that is still running signs up again on its own.

stream.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the address instead
stream.none: No live stream. The device is checked for one every few minutes, and it answers once Local Camera Streaming is applied on the Patchers screen.
stream.noneNoIp: No live stream. The device is checked for one every few minutes, and it answers once Local Camera Streaming is applied on the Patchers screen, and it has not reported an IP yet either.
stream.rtspNote: Give this one to Home Assistant as a Generic Camera. This app’s go2rtc stands between it and the device.
stream.direct: Straight from the device (VLC, ffmpeg; not Home Assistant):

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Custom sounds the {{noun}} can play, stored on this server.
sounds.tooMany: A device holds at most {{max}} sounds; delete one first
sounds.note: Up to {{max}} uploads ({{stored}} stored), 2 MB each. Play sends the sound to the device once, so you hear it there; Select makes it the one the device uses.
sounds.deleteBody: “{{name}}” is removed from this server and from the device’s list.

commands.destructiveNote: The device acts on it at once and it cannot be called back.
commands.label: Commands
commands.note: Each command asks before it runs.

capabilities.title: Media capabilities
capabilities.description: Turns an upload off at the source: nothing to prune and no bandwidth spent. Takes effect on the device's next upload-credential poll.

faces.none: No mugshots cached on the device yet. It re-reads them at boot and about once an hour; a reboot forces it.
faces.ours: {{head}}: yours, so the device is matching against your mugshots.
faces.foreign: {{head}}: not yours. It is still using photos from PetKit's cloud, which proxy mode hands it. Turn proxy off and reboot the device to switch it to your {{yours}}.

ai.title: On-device AI
ai.description: What this device's camera watches and listens for.

source.locale: the zone name the device reported

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.hint: Hours, -12 to 14 in quarter steps. Empty for automatic.
timezone.hintPending: Hours, -12 to 14 in quarter steps. Empty for automatic. Not sent yet.

logs.title: Debug log collection
logs.description: The firmware’s own view of what it was doing, in the <log>Log</log> screen.

today.title: Today
today.noZone: No device has said which time zone it is in yet.
today.noLanes: No pets, feeders or fountains to draw yet.

action.queued: Queued — delivers on the next heartbeat (about 10 s)

timezone.queued: Saved — applies on its next check-in

logReason.noBucketEndpoint: this app has no bucket address, so there is nowhere to send the device
logReason.authorityNotSplittable: the bucket address cannot be split into a host the device can build; it needs a dotted name or IP

entityHelp.yowlingDetection: Listens for meowing while a cat is in the box and records when it heard some. PetKit frames repeated yowling as a possible sign of discomfort. Beta in PetKit's app.
entityHelp.phDetection: Reads the colour of PetKit's own pH-indicator litter from the camera. With ordinary litter it measures nothing at all. Beta in PetKit's app.
entityHelp.vomitDetection: Watches for vomiting. A detection result carries a vomit_info list, which stays empty while this is off.

force.footnote: Asks for your password first. Refused while a cat is inside or the lid is open.
force.body: The drum turns again. The box paused because it saw a cat near the entrance.
force.risk: Look at the box before you continue. If a cat steps inside, the box stops again on its own; this app never overrides that.
force.label: Force continue
force.pausedWhy: The box stopped because it saw a cat near the entrance.
force.notOffered: Paused. Force continue is not offered: {{reasons}}
force.readFailed: Force continue and auto-pack could not be read. {{error}}

autoPack.title: Auto-pack
autoPack.intro: The box packs and seals the waste bag on its own when the rule says so. The server turns the rule off after a pack error or two unanswered packs, and never turns it on.
autoPack.advice: PetKit’s own advice for automatic packing: have someone nearby when the box packs, and take the bag out promptly.
autoPack.countedFrom: Cleanings are counted from the moment it is turned on.

trigger.daily_at: Every day at a set time

heldBack.cooldown: waiting a little after the last attempt
heldBack.not_delivered: the last pack command could not be sent
heldBack.state_stale: the box has not sent a state report in the last 2 minutes
heldBack.presence_unknown: the box has not said whether a pet is inside
heldBack.device_offline: the box has not been heard from in the last 90 seconds
heldBack.not_on_mqtt: the box is not connected over MQTT
heldBack.pet_in_box: the box reports a pet inside
heldBack.visit_open: a pet entered in the last 10 minutes and has not left
heldBack.pet_nearby: a pet was near the box in the last 2 minutes
heldBack.device_busy: the box is running a cycle
heldBack.no_bags: the box reports no bags left, or has not reported a bag count
heldBack.history_unavailable: the visit history could not be read

disabled.noResponse: the box did not answer two packs in a row
disabled.packError: the box reported a packing error: {{detail}}

status.turnedOff: Turned off by the server because {{reason}}
status.pending: Pack sent at {{at}}, waiting for the box
status.awaitingBinClear: Waiting for the bin to be emptied before it counts again
status.notYet: Not packed by this rule yet
status.noAnswer: the last pack got no answer

summary.dailyAt: every day at {{at}}, in the device's time zone
summary.plain: The box packs and seals the waste bag on its own {{when}}.
summary.withQuiet: The box packs and seals the waste bag on its own {{when}}, never between {{start}} and {{end}}.

fields.cleaningsHint: {{min}} to {{max}}, counted from the last pack or from turning the rule on.
fields.atHint: In the device's own time zone.
fields.quietHint: No automatic pack inside this window. An end before the start runs past midnight.

mode.webrtc: WebRTC: lowest delay, straight from the server.
mode.mse: MSE: about a second behind, over the same connection as this page.
mode.hls: HLS: works everywhere, a few seconds behind.

reason.deviceUnreachable: The camera has not reported its network address yet, so it cannot be reached.
reason.noStream: The camera has no live stream yet. Apply Local Camera Streaming on the Patchers screen.
reason.sidecarDown: The video relay (go2rtc) is not running on the server. Restart the add-on.
reason.unknown: The live stream is not available right now.

fail.hlsStopped: The HLS stream stopped and did not come back. Press Watch to try again.
fail.decodeDetail: The live video could not be decoded: {{detail}}
fail.decode: The live video could not be decoded.
fail.refused: The live stream refused the connection.
fail.format: This browser cannot play the stream's format ({{format}}).
fail.mseUnsupported: This browser cannot play MSE. Choose HLS instead.
fail.noCodecs: This browser plays none of the codecs the stream offers. Choose HLS instead.
fail.closed: The live stream closed. Press Watch to start it again.
fail.socket: Could not open the live stream connection.
fail.webrtcDropped: The WebRTC connection dropped. Check that this device can reach the server.
fail.noOffer: No local WebRTC offer was created.
fail.webrtcUnavailable: WebRTC is not set up on this server.

page.talkNote: Hold to talk is in the iPhone app. The web dashboard plays the picture and sound only.
page.panNote: The box turns the camera with its own tool. Home returns it to the centre. Each move asks before it runs.
page.noCamera: This device has no camera to watch.

live.nothingUntilWatch: Nothing connects until you press Watch.
live.checkFailed: Could not check the live stream: {{error}}

result.polled: Asked the relay for a reading
result.paired: Paired — the device picks it up on its next poll
result.capabilitySaved: Saved — takes effect on the device’s next upload-credential poll

page.loadBleFailed: Could not load the Bluetooth accessories: {{error}}
page.routeMqtt: It has a live MQTT session, so it runs now.
page.routeHeartbeat: It is not on MQTT, so it waits for its next HTTP heartbeat, about 10 seconds.
page.valuesFrom: Values from the last report at {{clock}}.
page.commandsOffline: Each command asks before it runs, then waits until the {{noun}} reports again.
page.unrecognised: This device type ({{type}}) is not recognised, so no Home Assistant entities are defined for it. It still connects, appears here and its traffic is logged; raw commands are under Entities and raw command.
page.liveCaption: Camera stream · WebRTC, MSE or HLS, also in Home Assistant
page.timesOfDayHint: A single time each, in the device's own day.

empty.title: Add your first device
empty.body: Keep this computer near a litter box, feeder or fountain: its Wi-Fi and this server's address are sent over Bluetooth. A device already running can instead be pointed at this server's address.

accessory.route: It travels over Bluetooth through its parent, which must be on MQTT.
accessory.readNote: Read now asks the relay to open a Bluetooth session; otherwise that happens on a timer up to the poll interval away. Each command asks before it runs.
accessory.scanGuess: The scan type for this model is a guess. Nobody has captured what a real {{type}} pairing carries, so {{scan}} is borrowed from its product line. If this accessory never reports, unpair it and pair again with a different scan type under Advanced, and please say which value worked.
accessory.nothingYet: Nothing reported yet. An accessory only speaks when its parent is asked to open a Bluetooth session to it.
accessory.settingsNote: Settings travel as one block, so a change needs a reading first; before the accessory has reported, a write is refused rather than guessed at.

headline.pausedWhy: The box saw a cat near the entrance.
headline.silentHint: Check that it has power and is on Wi-Fi.

screen.goneTitle: This device is not here any more
screen.goneBody: It was removed, or the link names a device this server never registered.

feeder.noFeed: This feeder takes no feed command.
feeder.asks: Asks before it runs. A running meal can be cancelled.

feederToday.noZone: The feeder has not said which time zone it is in.
feederToday.label: Today's meals

rawCard.title: Entities and raw command
rawCard.aside: What this device is reporting now
rawCard.unroutedNote: These entities are published to Home Assistant but this screen has no block for them. Please report it.
rawCard.noConnect: no MQTT connect seen; the device is on HTTP heartbeat
rawCard.patchers: Firmware changes for this device are on the <link>Patchers</link> screen.

invalid.periodOutside: A period has a time outside the day.
invalid.entryDays: Pick at least one day for each entry.
invalid.timeDays: Pick at least one day for each time.
invalid.timeOutside: A time is outside the day.
invalid.mealDays: Pick at least one day for each set of meals.
invalid.mealOutside: A meal time is outside the day.
invalid.portions: Portions are whole numbers from 0 to 255.

schedules.note: The device runs these on its own clock, in its own time zone. Nothing is set for you: an empty schedule does not restrict the device. A period that ends before it starts runs through midnight, which is how PetKit's own app writes quiet hours.
schedules.eatenOfFed: Eaten of what was fed today
schedules.zoneNote: Times use the device's own time zone, {{zone}}.

deferred.pickDateTime: Pick a date and a time.
deferred.loadFailed: One-off feeds could not be loaded: {{error}}
deferred.title: Deferred feed
deferred.aside: Sent when the feeder next polls
deferred.note: Date and time are on the feeder's own clock ({{zone}}). The feeder picks the meal up on its next check-in.

feedEditor.empty: No meals set. The feeder dispenses only when you press Feed.

mealSheet.title: Edit meal
mealSheet.repeatsEveryDay: {{name}}. Repeats every day, the days of its set.
mealSheet.repeatsOn: {{name}}. Repeats on {{days}}, the days of its set.
mealSheet.kept: Changes are kept in this schedule until you save it.

ranges.empty: Not set. Nothing here restricts the device; add a period to change that.

scheduleEditor.savedSent: Saved and sent to the device.
scheduleEditor.savedQueued: Saved. The device picks it up on its next poll.
